records.name: Dark Strike Fighter (Anime)
records.basis: The placeholder row has 2700 ATK and no script. Stats: 2600/1800, Level 7, DARK Machine Synchro Effect. The effect is a community reconstruction of 5D's episodes 21 and 134, unverified.
records.text:
[Anime card, a reconstruction of episodes 21 and 134: not verified] 1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
During either Main Phase, once per turn for each copy of this card: You can Tribute 1 other monster you control; inflict damage to your opponent equal to the Tributed monster's Level (as it was when Tributed) x 200. This card cannot attack during the turn you activate this effect.

records.name: Fortune Lady Fire (Anime)
records.basis: The placeholder row only says 'same as OCG'. The official card with one change: the destroy trigger works when this card is Special Summoned face-up in Attack Position by any means, with no Fortune Lady source required. The target (1 face-up monster the opponent controls) is the official card's, the rule the anime card's text gives too.
records.text: [Anime card, a reconstruction] This card's ATK/DEF become its Level x 200. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Increase this card's Level by 1 (max. 12). When this card is Special Summoned face-up in Attack Position, by any card or procedure (no "Fortune Lady" card needed): Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy that target, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the destroyed monster's ATK as it was before it was destroyed.

records.text: This card is not treated as a DARK monster while it is face-up on the field. If this card attacks, it gains ATK equal to twice the ATK of the monster it battles until the end of the Damage Step. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. When a card or effect is activated that would destroy this card: you can discard 1 card; negate its activation, and destroy it. If this card would be destroyed by battle, you can discard 1 card instead.
